title: Identity Confirmation Before Video Hearings — Unemployment Insurance Appeals and Claimant Identity Verification
content:
The appellant's own Claimant Identity Verification case on the appealed claim decides the identity check days of a video hearing session under Unemployment Insurance Appeals: whether such a case exists, the status it stands at, and the pathway through which it was verified.

**Rule.** The video identity check days are the unverified identity check days when the appellant holds an identity verification case on the appealed claim that stands in any status other than verified, the other-pathway identity check days when the appellant's case on that claim stands verified through a pathway other than a Video Trusted Referee Session, and zero days when the appellant's case stands verified through a Video Trusted Referee Session or the appellant holds no identity verification case on the appealed claim. These days are added to the video block gap, and the set hearing date is moved later by the total before the calendar-day rule is applied.

| The appellant's Claimant Identity Verification case on the appealed claim | Identity check days |
|---|---|
| exists and stands in any status other than verified | 6 (unverified identity check) |
| stands verified, through a pathway other than a Video Trusted Referee Session | 3 (other-pathway identity check) |
| stands verified through a Video Trusted Referee Session | 0 |
| none held on the appealed claim | 0 |

## Points of judgement

- The case read is the one on the claim the appeal names. A case on another claim does not decide the days.
- For a case that is not verified, the pathway does not matter: any status other than verified gives 6 days.
- For a verified case, only the pathway matters: a Video Trusted Referee Session gives 0 days, every other pathway 3 days.

*Hypothetical cases:* a case on the appealed claim verified through a Video Trusted Referee Session — 0 days; a case verified through Online Identity Proofing (IAL2) — 3 days; a case standing in a status other than verified — 6 days; no case on the appealed claim — 0 days.
